study: A03E8 post-E7 physics-only fixed-F± resonant neutrino occupation response, exact FD-relative source coefficient; NOT eBOSS observed galaxy xi prediction
preregistered_relative_to: Only this new source-only reconstruction and diagnostic tests; original DESI direction and full mock E7 results are already fixed and inspected.

fixed_low_z_direction.origin: Prior published seven-coefficient DESI forecast direction, no eBOSS reoptimization

fixed_physics.coefficient_source: existing wake_phase7_template.COEFF (seven numbers parsed from exact SHA source)
fixed_physics.z_0p95_label: Mathematical midpoint of original [0.9,1.0) high-z pilot, NOT measured z_eff
fixed_physics.velocity_200_label: Original 200 km/s control reference used in earlier hidden-channel response study, NOT eBOSS measured vrel

physical_reference.paper: Okoli et al., Dynamical friction in the primordial neutrino sea, MNRAS 468 (2017) 2164-2175
physical_reference.relevant_equations: Collisionless linear response Eq.(14)-(19) and exact resonant FD occupation in Eq.(19), replacing FD occupation by alternative isotropic positive F while holding mass, potential and relative velocity fixed.
physical_reference.assumption: Ratio of exact resonant imaginary source for F± to FD when same shift/single-species degeneracy and isotropic equilibrium. Does not include independently modified evolving halo potential/velocity distribution.

deliverables: F0,F+,F- original q grid with physical CLASS source normalization and three moments
FD-relative F±(qres)/F0(qres) and (F+-F-)/F0 dimensionless conditional source coefficients
Signed and sign-swap negative controls, positivity, 30% cap, exact moment match
No max-normalization of output, no arbitrary fitted amplitude
not_deliverables: Absolutely calibrated eBOSS ξ1 or ξ3
Physically complete collisionless wake with altered halo velocity field
Tracer-specific LRG/ELG nonlinear response/HOD, magnification or evolution biases
downstream_gate: Real eBOSS galaxy-space amplitude requires separately specified sign-oriented physical wake-to-tracer operator, measured tracer biases and selection, z-conditioned window and independent eBOSS C; NOT identifiable from F(q) alone.
